preconditions.description: The number of employees in the company is between 1 and 100,000.
The number of pairs of people who don't like each other is between 0 and 100,000.
Each employee is numbered between 1 and n.
The number of salary revisions is between 0 and 100,000.
Each salary revision is for an existing employee.

postconditions.description: The first output should be the number of dangerous triples at the beginning of the first day.
Each subsequent output should be the number of dangerous triples at the beginning of the i-th day after the salary revisions.

invariants.expression: all(a_i != b_i for a_i, b_i in hate_pairs)
all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n for a_i, b_i in hate_pairs)
invariants.description: All employees are numbered between 1 and n.

invariants.expression: all(v_i in range(1, n + 1) for v_i in salary_revisions)
invariants.description: All salary revisions are for existing employees.
